title: gralloch hypothesis ledger
description: The case's tracked hypotheses. Array of hypotheses, or {"hypotheses":[...]}. A hypothesis may be 'confirmed' only with an 'evidence' reference to an artifact in the case. Statements/evidence are sample-derived and untrusted.

source.description: static | string | guess | capa | yara | deobfuscate | dynamic

evidence.description: path to a trace/log/dump in the case (required for confirmed)
